name: 3d-force-graph
author: Vasco Asturiano
notes: Self-contained UMD bundle exposing the global ForceGraph3D. Version 1.70.2 is pinned because it targets three.js ^0.128.0, matching the vendored three.min.js r128 that is loaded first and preferred via window.THREE. Loads no remote assets at runtime. Used by the Dashboard knowledge-graph visual for the optional 3D view.
